project.name: NEUROGLYPHS
project.description: 3D glyph-field game: fly through a neural network of symbols, collect tokens into a bounded context window, trigger inference events that mutate the world.

module.provides: glyph field, network topology, synapses, signal pulses
glyph alphabet, seeded PRNG, level definitions

flow.step: World builds glyph field (seeded) + network topology
Player moves near a token glyph
Context system appends token (evict oldest if full)
Inference system checks for completed target sequence
Target token sequence detected in context window
Inference event fires: world mutation (new field region, gate opens, glyph recolor)
Inference event emits a pulse at trigger node
Pulse travels along synapses with speed + decay
Glyphs near active synapses brighten / shift hue

invariants.invariant: World generation uses seeded PRNG only
Context window size is fixed per level; overflow handled explicitly
Same seed + same player path = same token set

entry.role: HTML shell + HUD mount + main.js import
Bootstrap: create engine, wire modules, start loop
